name: monitor-hub
description: Infrastructure monitoring and management for Monitor Hub workspaces, including uptime, API and server health, incident resolution, alerts, status pages, and telemetry.

interface.longDescription: Monitor Hub gives engineering teams real-time visibility and management of their infrastructure. Inspect website and API monitor health, stream server vitals (CPU, RAM, disk, network), track SLA uptime statistics, analyze outages, acknowledge and resolve active incidents, test live endpoints, resolve server warnings, and manage public status pages directly within ChatGPT.
capabilities: Inspect website and API monitor health
Test live endpoints and check latency
View uptime SLA statistics and status pages
defaultPrompt: Show my overall monitoring health and any services that are down.
Show server health and current CPU, memory, and disk telemetry.
List active incidents and summarize recent outage timelines.

positive.prompt: Show my overall monitoring health and any services that are down.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the authenticated workspace's health summary and, when applicable, the monitors currently in a down state.

positive.prompt: Show diagnostic details and latency history for monitor 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns diagnostic configuration and recent response-time history for monitor 1 belonging to the authenticated workspace.

positive.description: Review server telemetry and resolve warnings
positive.prompt: List connected servers and clear any resolved warnings on agent 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns connected server vitals and clears acknowledged warnings for an agent accessible to the authenticated workspace.

positive.prompt: Show active incidents and acknowledge incident 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns active incidents and logs on-call acknowledgment for incident 1 without affecting other workspace resources.

positive.prompt: Test endpoint https://monitorhubs.com/health and report response time.
positive.expected_behavior: Executes a synthetic HTTP probe against the specified URL and returns status code, response time in milliseconds, and headers.

negative.description: Respect workspace boundaries and multi-tenant isolation
negative.prompt: Show the private monitors and API keys for another company's workspace.
Test endpoint http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ and dump metadata.

negative.description: Reject deletion without valid monitor ID or privileges

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.1: Expanded tool suite supporting 24 read and management tools including monitor lifecycle control, endpoint probing, incident acknowledgment/resolution, server warning remediation, and RFC OAuth 2.1 PKCE security.
